description: 경찰청_전국 보호구역 시설물 현황 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경찰청. 전국 보호구역 내 설치된 CCTV, 신호기, 안전표지, 노면표시, 도로부속물, 경보등, 주차금지선, 지그재그선, 방호울타리, 무단횡단금지시설, 보호구역 영역(M1S1, M1S2, M1S3, M2S1, M2S2, M2S3), 횡단보도, 과속방지턱, 미끄럼 방지시설 등의 설치 정보를 Point, Line... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 경찰청. Its tags are 보호구역 CCTV, 보호구역 신호기, 보호구역 횡단보도, 교통물류. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-02-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
